answers.core: It's already core, it's just unfinished/broken.
answers.workaround: This will be used incredibly often. The only workaround I can think of currently is to split my tilesheet into N separate tilesheets, each of which is Mx1 dimensions, where N is the number of Autotile sets I want, and M is the number of tiles in each Autotile set, such that I can draw contiguous rectangles in the editor. This is incredibly unreasonable for obvious reasons. Maybe there's a way to do this with a script in Godot.. but re-inventing Autotile in a script seems tedious and silly.
